items.context: Root (@therationalroot, 212K seguidores, analista on-chain y de ciclos), con su gráfico "Bitcoin Spiral" (precio en escala log en espiral de 4 años con ATHs, mínimos y halvings marcados): "The 4-year cycle: A new bottom dot. #Bitcoin". Post de ~40 min con 338 likes, 36 respuestas, 36 reposts y 38 guardados, creciendo rápido.
items.suggested_text:
The spiral makes the rhythm look clean, but each red dot hides how different the lap felt from the inside. After the 2011 top, BTC fell 92.7% and needed 622 days to reclaim the high. After the late-2013 top it fell 84.5% and took 1,177 days, almost twice as long, even though the first 2013 peak had been recovered in just 210.

Same 4-year geometry, very different recovery clocks. A bottom only marks where the drawdown stops, not how long the climb back takes.

I mapped every cycle's drop and recovery time here: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122375393776951738

The second number is usually the one that tests conviction more than the first.
